commands.name: keepwarm
commands.description: Keep the prompt cache warm: bare for 6h, a window such as 90m, always, off, or status (token-tax-weather)
commands.output: keepwarm on for 6h00m, a ping 50m after each idle stretch keeps the cache read, not re-written

commands.name: cache-tax
commands.description: Prompt cache state, cold price and this session's cold writes (token-tax-weather)
commands.output:
claude-opus-5-5
state       warm, 1h00m left
context     97,400 tokens, the most the cache can be holding
window      200k (49% used), no compaction window reported, so the model window is used
cache read  91,000 tokens served from cache last turn (93% of context)
unit prices input 0.0007 · read 0.005 · write 0 · output 0.6 USD/MTok (user-supplied rates; prices, not costs)
for 97.4k tokens   re-write $0.00 (write rate) · from cache $0.0005 (read rate) · no cache $0.0001 (input rate)
cache effect  +$0.0004 for this context: "from cache" minus "no cache". Negative is a saving — the read rate is below the input rate, so being warm lowers the bill by that much. Positive is a surcharge — the read rate is above the input rate, so the cache costs more than it saves
keepwarm    on, 6h00m left
break-even  warming cannot pay for itself at these rates: a cold re-write is billed at nothing, so every ping is a net cost
guard       warn only, always. This mod never drops a prompt.
session     0 cold writes paid, $0.00

commands.name: cache-tax-diagnostic
commands.description: Read-only pricing provenance diagnostic; no inference or warming.
commands.output:
Pricing diagnostic (read-only)

Cost rates this mod uses: user-supplied rates (USD / million tokens)
  input=0.0007; output=0.6; cacheRead=0.005; cacheWrite=0
Desktop-managed pricing: pricing unavailable
Provenance / reason: No valid managed exact override. Ordinary sources are ignored; host SDK fallback may not appear in settings. Canonical matching is unimplemented.
Source snapshots (pricing fields only):
  policy: absent
  user: absent
  project: absent
  local: absent
  flag: absent
  merged: absent
Matching: exact model ID only; canonical matching is unimplemented.
Behavior: nothing here warms or sends on its own — a model call happens only while a /keepwarm window is armed. No prompt is ever dropped, and no settings are written.
Prompt Cache / Response Cache observations: not exposed to a plugin by this engine build; the gateway-side response-cache controls are a separate ticket.
